Findings first: **no actionable correctness, provenance, packaging-scope, or qualification-claim findings**. Recommendation: **PASS AC1–AC5 for the bounded artifact-only stage**, subject to root final acceptance. This review does not accept full P6 or authorize runtime use.

Only this temporary report was authored.

Read-only independent archive/source assertions completed successfully:

- All 1865 manifest entries match retained source bytes and safe regular-file source-tar members; manifest/archive hashes match permanent bindings. Inventory equals root's 1864-file baseline plus tracked ignored .DS_Store. Exclusion is .claude/settings.local.json; no missing tracked files. Every other baseline candidate byte outside the four publication paths remains unchanged; all build-copy source bytes match the frozen source.

Removing the one new structural test produces an AST identical to the old test module. Evidence: pyproject.toml:155–165; tests/migration/test_p6_release_rehearsal.py:70–82. Existing archive assertions were preserved.
- Actual corrected wheel is 1280 members / SHA256 3c72e14e4358f33368904c9bad138c4c301889a70b7acaf3d12665df17fb26ff; sdist is 1281 members / SHA256 7ce14291f9133a8a38320aae1238dc5c2233fd90121f417bdec5089f0c2213fe. Both contain no node_modules/.venv/.git/cache/runtime or .DS_Store members. All source-matching members equal frozen inputs; 587 generated assets in each archive match the real disposable frontend build and each other. Wheel RECORD covers every member exactly and validates every hash/size. Console scripts match the public project mapping. Actual METADATA/PKG-INFO name/version/Python requirement, extras set and dependency counts agree with the manifest. Root's unchanged inspector independently reports zero missing/forbidden, with exact guard and service validity.
- Retained artifact-inspection.json and all retained helper hash/size bindings match actual files; embedded literal raw-run objects equal retained JSON. Source/archive/manifest/inspection/ignored-lock outputs are 0400; corrected bundle is 0700. Actual failed sdist is retained read-only, matches its recorded hash and still contains 910 node_modules members. No history was relabeled green.

## AC recommendations

**AC1 PASS.** Complete dirty provenance is recorded with HEAD/branch/status and per-file hash/size/mode, not HEAD-only release provenance. Freeze helper rejects symlinks/special files before content reads; source archive independently checked for regular safe members. .DS_Store is private source metadata, not public packaging input. Guard/P5/runtime and unrelated baseline hashes remain unchanged. Evidence: p6-artifact-checkpoint.md:12–34; source-manifest.json; dirty-source.tar.gz; root-scope-check.json.

**AC2 PASS.** Raw records establish distinct network-enabled acquisition into a new private environment/disposable copy, pinned build/Hatchling versions and resolved tool versions, unchanged frontend lock, npm ci --ignore-scripts with explicit blank whitespace-only user/global configs and private cache. Original frozen Hatch hook executes twice and legitimately reuses the newly built fresh assets; no skip flag/synthetic replacement exists in the recorded environment or source delta. Build-copy source equality independently checked. Existing environments/assets/ignored lock are not promoted to release qualification. Evidence: p6-artifact-checkpoint.md:52–65; qualify.py; frontend-acquisition.json; frontend-build.json; archive-build.json.

**AC3 PASS.** Actual archive, RECORD, public entrypoint, metadata, generated-asset and frozen-source bindings corroborate root's existing-inspector green. Corrected sdist retains original hook/project/license/notices and actual prebuilt assets. Root webui source exclusion is documented existing policy, not represented as new frontend source rebuild availability. Evidence: p6-artifact-checkpoint.md:69–86; artifact-inspection.json; actual dist archives; root-artifact-qualification.json.

**AC4 PASS.** Raw final root full-denial argv/output records exactly 32 selected passes and six deselected old state/CLI-state cases. Exact version source-checkout node separately passes with only the frozen interpreter exec allowlist and all network denied. Earlier full-fork-denial version failure is retained truthfully, not waived. This review inspected existing raw results; it did not rerun tests or state rehearsal. Evidence: p6-artifact-checkpoint.md:88–95; root-archive-full-denial-final.json; root-version-local-process-final.json; root-archive-tests.json.

**AC5 PASS recommendation.** Four permanent docs accurately keep publication/review pending for root to finalize, P6 IN_PROGRESS/full P6 NOT_ACCEPTED, runtime NOT_READY/NOT_AUTHORIZED and D9 NOT_AUTHORIZED. P5 history remains unchanged. Source freeze predates publication bytes and docs explicitly state that boundary. Permanent evidence embeds raw commands/results and binds retained inventories.
